title: Module 2: Computer Ethics and Professional Codes
subject: SEPC311

questions.question: A set of guidelines designed to set out acceptable behavior and ethical standards for members of a particular group, association, or profession is called a professional code of ____.
questions.explanation: A professional code of ethics sets out explicit standards of acceptable behavior, responsibility, and integrity for practitioners in a profession.

questions.question: Which of the following is recognized as one of the four foundational benefits of ethical guidelines for professionals?
questions.explanation: Ethical guidelines provide structured frameworks that assist practitioners in navigating complex moral dilemmas through ethical decision-making.

questions.question: Professional codes of ethics instill high standards of practice and ethical behavior, fostering trust and ____ from the general public.
questions.explanation: Adhering to strict professional codes establishes credibility, earning the enduring trust and respect of clients and the general public.

questions.question: A professional code of ethics serves as an evaluation ____ against which the competence, conduct, and accountability of a practitioner can be measured.
questions.explanation: Codes of ethics provide an objective evaluation benchmark for auditing professional performance and disciplining malpractice.

questions.question: According to Tenet 1 of the Code of Ethics of the Filipino IT Professionals, members pledge to promote public knowledge, understanding, and ____ of Information Technology.
questions.explanation: Tenet 1: 'I will promote public knowledge, understanding and appreciation of I.T.'

questions.question: According to Tenet 2 of the Filipino IT Code, what must an IT professional always consider in the performance of their professional work?
questions.explanation: Tenet 2: 'I will consider the general welfare and public welfare and public good in the performance of my work.'

questions.question: Tenet 3 of the Filipino IT Code states that professionals must advertise goods or professional services in a clear and ____ manner.
questions.explanation: Tenet 3: 'I will advertise goods or professional services in a clear and truthful manner.'

questions.question: Tenet 4 of the Filipino IT Code mandates strict compliance and adherence to intellectual property laws, ____ laws, and other related technology statutes.
questions.explanation: Tenet 4: 'I will comply and strictly abide by the intellectual property laws, patent laws and other related laws in respect of I.T.'

questions.question: Under Tenet 5 of the Filipino IT Code, practitioners must accept full responsibility for work undertaken and utilize their skills with competence and ____.
questions.explanation: Tenet 5: 'I will accept the full responsibility for the work undertaken and utilize my skills with competence and professionalism.'

questions.question: Tenet 6 of the Filipino IT Code obligates professionals to make truthful statements regarding what aspect of their qualifications and offerings?
options: Areas of competence and product qualities
questions.answer: Areas of competence and product qualities
questions.explanation: Tenet 6: 'I will make truthful statements on my areas of competence as well as the capabilities and qualities of my product and services.'

questions.question: Under Tenet 7 of the Filipino IT Code, an IT professional must never disclose or use confidential information obtained during duty without consent, except when required by ____.
questions.explanation: Tenet 7: 'I will not disclose or use any confidential information obtained in course of professional duties without the consent of the parties concerned except when required by the laws.'

questions.question: Tenet 8 of the Filipino IT Code requires members to strive to attain the highest ____ in both the products and services that they offer.
questions.explanation: Tenet 8: 'I will strive to attain the highest quality in both the products and services that offer.'

questions.question: Tenet 9 of the Filipino IT Code emphasizes active industry advancement by pledging to knowingly participate in the ____ of Information Technology.
questions.explanation: Tenet 9: 'I will knowingly participate in the development of the Information Technology.'

questions.question: Tenet 10 of the Filipino IT Code requires practitioners to uphold and enhance standards through continuing professional ____ to elevate the profession.
questions.explanation: Tenet 10 mandates continuous learning to uphold and improve professional standards across the computing industry.

questions.question: What does the professional acronym AITP stand for in computing ethics?
questions.explanation: AITP stands for the Association of Information Technology Professionals, a key organization defining computing ethical standards.

questions.question: How many key institutional obligations does a member solemnly accept in the AITP Code of Ethics?
questions.explanation: The AITP Code specifies 6 primary obligations: to management, fellow members, society, university/college, employer, and country.

questions.question: Which of the following is an explicit obligation declared in the AITP Code of Ethics acknowledging institutional academic roots?
options: Obligation to my College or University
questions.answer: Obligation to my College or University
questions.explanation: The AITP Code explicitly highlights 'an obligation to my College or University' to honor academic foundations and mentor future professionals.

questions.question: In the AITP Code of Ethics, members explicitly acknowledge holding a fiduciary trust toward whom?
questions.explanation: AITP members pledge: 'That I have an obligation to my employer whose trust I hold.'

questions.question: According to the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics, how many core principles govern professional practice?
questions.explanation: The ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics contains 8 core principles: Public, Client & Employer, Product, Judgement, Management, Profession, Colleagues, Self.

questions.question: Which ACM Principle states that software engineers shall act consistently with the public interest as their paramount obligation?
questions.explanation: Principle 1 (Public) mandates that software engineers shall act consistently with the safety, health, and welfare of the public.

questions.question: Which ACM Principle requires that software engineers ensure their software products and modifications meet the highest professional standards possible?
questions.explanation: Principle 3 (Product) requires software engineers to strive for high quality, acceptable costs, and rigorous testing.

questions.question: Which ACM Principle dictates that software engineers maintain integrity and independence in their professional evaluations?
questions.explanation: Principle 4 (Judgement) requires software engineers to maintain integrity and objectivity, refusing to endorse compromised technical assessments.

questions.question: Which ACM Principle obligates practitioners to participate in lifelong learning to enhance their professional capabilities?
questions.explanation: Principle 8 (Self) states that software engineers shall participate in lifelong professional education to keep pace with technological advancement.

questions.question: Which organization formulated the globally recognized 'Ten Commandments of Computer Ethics'?
questions.explanation: The Ten Commandments of Computer Ethics were created in 1992 by the Computer Ethics Institute (CEI) to govern responsible computer usage.

questions.question: What is the 1st Commandment of Computer Ethics?
options: Thou shalt not use a computer to harm other people
Thou shalt not copy proprietary software
Thou shalt not snoop around in other people's files
Thou shalt not use a computer to steal
questions.answer: Thou shalt not use a computer to harm other people
questions.explanation: Commandment 1: 'Thou shalt not use a computer to harm other people', prohibiting harassment, physical injury, and cyber attacks.

questions.question: Commandment 2 states that computer users must not interfere with other people's computer ____.
questions.explanation: Commandment 2: 'Thou shalt not interfere with other people's computer work', barring denial-of-service attacks, malware, and disruptive tactics.

questions.question: Commandment 3 explicitly forbids users from snooping around in other people's computer ____.
questions.explanation: Commandment 3: 'Thou shalt not snoop around in other people's computer files', protecting digital privacy and data confidentiality.

questions.question: Which Commandment prohibits the use of computer technologies to commit theft of money, data, or electronic assets?
options: Commandment 4: Thou shalt not use a computer to steal
questions.answer: Commandment 4: Thou shalt not use a computer to steal
questions.explanation: Commandment 4: 'Thou shalt not use a computer to steal', prohibiting financial fraud, unauthorized data harvesting, and cyber robbery.

questions.question: Commandment 5 ('Thou shalt not use a computer to bear false witness') directly outlaws which modern digital misconduct?
options: Spreading online disinformation, defamation, and fake news
questions.answer: Spreading online disinformation, defamation, and fake news
questions.explanation: Commandment 5 prohibits online slander, perjury, forged documentation, and spreading malicious disinformation.

questions.question: Which Commandment prohibits software piracy and the illegal downloading or copying of proprietary software without paying licensing fees?
questions.explanation: Commandment 6: 'Thou shalt not copy or use proprietary software for which you have not paid.'

questions.question: Commandment 7 prohibits using other people's computer resources without authorization or proper ____.
questions.explanation: Commandment 7: 'Thou shalt not use other people's computer resources without authorization or proper compensation.'

questions.question: Commandment 8 specifically forbids appropriating other people's intellectual output, which is known academically as ____.
questions.explanation: Commandment 8 protects intellectual property, forbidding users from claiming another person's code, design, or research as their own.

questions.question: Commandment 9 directs developers to think about the social ____ of the program they are writing or system they are designing.
questions.explanation: Commandment 9: 'Thou shalt think about the social consequences of the program you are writing or the system you are designing.'

questions.question: What does the 10th Commandment of Computer Ethics exhort all computer users to always insure when using technology?
options: Consideration and respect for your fellow humans
questions.answer: Consideration and respect for your fellow humans
questions.explanation: Commandment 10: 'Thou shalt always use a computer in ways that insure consideration and respect for your fellow humans.'

questions.question: The declaration known as the Hacking Community's Constitution serves as a digital bill of rights that hackers argue should be interpreted in relation to what other ethical document?
options: The Ten Commandments of Computer Ethics
questions.answer: The Ten Commandments of Computer Ethics
questions.explanation: The Hacking Community's Constitution declares 14 principles akin to a cyber bill of rights, intended to be read alongside the Ten Commandments.

questions.question: According to the Hacking Constitution, hacking is legitimately viewed as a tool to test the ____ of networks that safeguard valuable information.
questions.explanation: Hackers view ethical hacking as an essential diagnostic tool to stress-test network integrity and uncover critical vulnerabilities before adversaries do.

questions.question: Which movement does the Hacking Community's Constitution passionately support, advocating that governments avoid closed proprietary software?
questions.explanation: The constitution strongly supports open-source software, arguing that government reliance on proprietary software stifles public innovation.

questions.question: The Hacking Community's Constitution declares that three instruments—hacking, cracking, and ____—can be leveraged to promote direct democracy and free information.
questions.explanation: The constitution cites hacking, cracking, and phreaking (telecom exploration) as tools for exploring systems and democratizing information.

questions.question: Which philosopher wrote the seminal 1985 paper 'What Is Computer Ethics?', establishing computer ethics as a distinct field of applied ethics?
questions.explanation: James H. Moor pioneered foundational computer ethics in 1985, analyzing policy vacuums and the unique nature of computing technology.

questions.question: James Moor argued that computer ethics problems typically arise because computers create a '____ vacuum' regarding how technology should be used.
questions.explanation: A 'policy vacuum' occurs when novel computer capabilities arise before society, laws, or institutions have established rules to govern their use.

questions.question: Which unique property of computers describes their capability to be shaped and molded to perform any activity characterized by inputs, outputs, and logical operations?
questions.explanation: Logical malleability is the computer's universal capacity to execute any computable process that can be formulated in logic.

questions.question: According to James Moor, which property of computers refers to the fact that most internal operational processes take place completely out of human sight?
questions.explanation: The Invisibility Factor emphasizes that internal micro-operations, algorithmic decisions, and data transactions are invisible to human perception.

questions.question: Which dimension of Moor's Invisibility Factor describes the covert, unauthorized, and undetectable misuse of computing power (such as digital embezzlement or espionage)?
questions.explanation: Invisible abuse occurs when a programmer or user exploits the hidden nature of digital systems to execute unauthorized or criminal operations unnoticed.

questions.question: When a programmer intentionally or subconsciously embeds personal biases, moral judgments, or unfair algorithmic assumptions into software code, it illustrates ____.
questions.explanation: Invisible programming values are the hidden philosophical, ethical, or discriminatory assumptions silently encoded into algorithms by developers.

questions.question: Complex financial automated trading or spacecraft telemetry calculations that exceed human capacity to inspect or audit by hand exemplify which aspect of the Invisibility Factor?
questions.explanation: Invisible complex calculations involve software processing so vast and intricate that human operators must blindly trust the machine's conclusions.

questions.question: Which level of computer ethics consists of sensationalized reporting, public curiosity, and news coverage in magazines, newspapers, and television programs?
questions.explanation: Pop computer ethics encompasses mainstream media discussions, sensational viral news, and popular public discourse on cyber issues.

questions.question: Which level of computer ethics is practiced by people who take a dedicated interest in cyber cases, collect examples, analyze similarities, and attend professional conferences?
questions.explanation: Para computer ethics is practiced by dedicated enthusiasts and professionals who systematically collect and analyze computing cases.

questions.question: Which level of computer ethics applies rigorous, scholarly philosophical frameworks (such as Kantianism and Utilitarianism) to technological dilemmas?
questions.explanation: Theoretical computer ethics is the academic discipline that integrates classical normative philosophy with computing dilemmas.

questions.question: Due to exceptionally high internet usage, mobile messaging volume, and viral social engagement, the Philippines has earned what global title?
options: Social Media Capital of the World
questions.answer: Social Media Capital of the World
questions.explanation: The Philippines is recognized globally as the 'Social Media Capital of the World' due to its unprecedented per-capita social media engagement.

questions.question: In digital social networking etiquette, if a friend willingly poses and smiles with you in a joint group photo or selfie, do you legally and ethically need to ask separate written permission before posting it?
options: Yes, copyright fees must be paid
No, because photos have no rights
Not anymore, because consent is implied
questions.answer: Not anymore, because consent is implied
questions.explanation: Voluntarily participating in a mutual group photo or selfie carries implied consent to share, provided it is not maliciously altered or defamatory.

questions.question: Secretly recording or photographing a private individual in a private setting without their knowledge or consent and uploading it to social media is generally ____.
questions.explanation: Capturing and broadcasting photos/videos of private individuals without consent violates privacy and ethical norms unless specific legal exemptions apply.

questions.question: Which legal exemption permits the unauthorized publication of photos or videos if the material captures breaking news of the day and press information (e.g., a rescue operation on EDSA)?
options: Exemption No. 1: News of the day and items of press information
questions.answer: Exemption No. 1: News of the day and items of press information
questions.explanation: Exemption 1 permits broadcasting recordings that constitute legitimate news of the day and press information in the public interest.

questions.question: If a citizen captures a video of an abusive traffic enforcer illegally extorting and threatening a delivery truck driver, publishing it is ethically and legally justified under which exemption?
options: Exemption No. 2: Done for the general welfare and public good
questions.answer: Exemption No. 2: Done for the general welfare and public good
questions.explanation: Exemption 2 justifies publishing unauthorized recordings when exposing abuse or corruption to protect the general welfare and public interest.

questions.question: Photographing or filming the popular Filipino pop group BINI while they are performing or walking in a public shopping mall is legally permissible under which exemption?
options: Exemption No. 3: Public personalities in a public setting
questions.answer: Exemption No. 3: Public personalities in a public setting
questions.explanation: Exemption 3 recognizes that public figures and celebrities appearing in public venues possess reduced expectations of privacy regarding public photography.

questions.question: Which comprehensive textbook serves as the foundational academic reference for SEPC311 at OLFU, written by Dr. Charlemagne Laviña?
options: Social, Ethical, Legal and Professional Issues in Computing
questions.answer: Social, Ethical, Legal and Professional Issues in Computing
questions.explanation: The core textbook referenced throughout the course is 'Social, Ethical, Legal and Professional Issues in Computing' by Dr. Charlemagne Laviña.
